description: Paper 3 Regime B – explicit RVE (G4PVParameterised) nanoparticle geometry for ternary HDPE/Bi2O3/WO3 composite. 1-µm cubic RVE with 1528 Bi2O3 spheres (R=25 nm) at phi_Bi2O3=0.10 in the full ternary effective medium (rho_eff=2.366 g/cm3). The inter-sphere medium is approximated as HDPE (the structural matrix phase); the WO3 phase is absorbed into the effective medium. Dual K-edges: Bi at 90.526 keV and W at 69.525 keV. 10M histories/point.
